Hair salon

A moment on the high street

What the photograph records

Tony Voyage Hair Salon at 7 Clapham High Street, London SW4 7TS, photographed on 29 October 2026. The cream salon sign and glass frontage replace the blue Pure Vintage fascia and shuttered appearance documented in April.

Photographed
29 October 2026
Recorded state
Occupied when photographed
Business type

This record describes the premises on the photograph date. Later changes may not yet be included in the archive.

A few dates in the story

  1. 31 January 2025 Reported · unconfirmed

    Pure Vintage: reported opening

    An Instagram reel shared with the project suggests Pure Vintage opened on this date. It has not yet been independently confirmed.

    Opening-date reel on Instagram ↗
  2. 3 April 2026 Documented

    Pure Vintage: closed by this date

    The project photographer confirms Pure Vintage had ceased trading at this address by the time this photograph was taken. The exact closing date is unknown.

  3. 29 October 2026 Documented

    Tony Voyage photographed here

    Tony Voyage Hair Salon at 7 Clapham High Street, London SW4 7TS, photographed on 29 October 2026. The cream salon sign and glass frontage replace the blue Pure Vintage fascia and shuttered appearance documented in April. This documents the business on the photograph date, not its opening date.

The exact changeover date between the observations on 3 April 2026 and 29 October 2026 is not yet known.
